research.title: Probability Calibration Under Class Imbalance and Distribution Shift
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to examine how training class imbalance and shifted test distributions affect probabilistic classifier calibration.
Compared sigmoid and isotonic calibration using held-out validation sets, reliability diagrams, and bootstrap uncertainty estimates while checking for data leakage.

projects.title: Regularized Regression Under Correlated Features
bullets: Implemented ridge, lasso, and elastic net regression pipelines with standardized features and cross-validation for selecting regularization parameters.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability across synthetic datasets with correlated predictors, varying noise levels, and irrelevant features.

projects.title: Clustering with Gaussian Mixture Models
bullets: Implemented expectation-maximization for Gaussian mixtures with diagonal and full covariance structures, including initialization checks and convergence monitoring.
Compared mixture models with k-means on synthetic clusters with unequal dispersion, examining assignment agreement and sensitivity to initialization.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Regression Prediction Intervals
bullets: Implemented split conformal prediction around linear regression and random forest models, separating training, calibration, and evaluation data.
Compared interval coverage and width under constant and input-dependent noise, inspecting conditional coverage across predefined regions of the feature space.
